integrity: The proof is symbolic. The weighted-shift constant and endpoint behavior are taken from and independently matched to the displayed formulas in the focal literature; the direct-sum constant and exponent threshold are derived exactly. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The invariant records only the supremal strong absolute-Cesàro exponent; endpoint membership is not classified in general.
The realization theorem uses reducible positive operators built from a nilpotent block and a weighted shift and does not address irreducible or invertible subclasses.
